decisions.reason: Healthcare and hospitality recruitment is far from the maritime direction the firm has announced, but it has stayed on the website for two years and draws on the existing crewing infrastructure, so management is likely to persist rather than admit the diversification failed.
Superyacht crew recruitment builds directly on the firm's core crewing network and has been visibly offered since 2023, so there is little reason to abandon it.
The Smart Academy was publicly launched with a growing partner network of six institutions, is central to the firm's training identity, and shows positive early results.
Emissions monitoring under FuelEU Maritime is regulation-driven, close to the core offer, central to the announced environmental direction, and already delivered on time for all vessels.
The emissions compliance dashboard fits the announced digitalisation and environmental strategy and complements the monitoring service, so the firm will keep investing in it.

The cost simulation tool is only mentioned on the website, but it belongs to the publicly committed emissions compliance suite, and weak uptake can still be blamed on the early phase of the regulation.
